coverage_note: Single-question video on a GATE CSE 2006 question about a binary operator defined by a table. The caption track is Devanagari ASR of Hindi and is too noisy to quote, so the question text and answer are not recorded as a PYQ here.
concepts: A binary operator given by a two-row table is being tested for which algebraic properties it satisfies (commutativity, associativity and the like).
The readable fragments are about checking a property of the operator by substituting values, which is the functional-completeness style of reasoning used in this topic.
gate_claims: The video title names GATE CSE 2006. The paper was not opened for this run, so no PYQ record is created from it.
